name: VBO Workflow Transition
description: Provides a views bulk operation action that can transition entities that are part of a workflow.
project_description: VBO Workflow Transition adds a single Views Bulk Operations action, 'Transition content to a new workflow state', that moves content-moderation entities through their workflow in bulk. From a View that lists moderated entities (with the 'Views bulk operations' field added), a user selects rows, chooses one of the transitions actually available to them, optionally writes a revision log message, and confirms. The action scans the selection, groups entities by the transitions the current user is allowed to make, shows how many of the selected entities can make each transition (including their current/latest moderation state), and on submit saves a new revision on each eligible entity with the new moderation state. There is no configuration page: you enable the module and add the 'Global: Views bulk operations' field to a View of moderated content. It differs from Moderated Content Bulk Publish (which uses core Actions and only offers Draft/Unpublish/Publish) by offering any transition available to the user via a single VBO action.
